headline: Approved a $175.96 sewer credit for 414 South Elm Street; also approved the August 2026 Director's Report.
summary: A customer appeal for a sewer credit at 414 South Elm Street was decided. The customer repaired an outside spigot leak on September 9, 2026, and later water use returned to normal. The commission approved a $175.96 credit and approved the Director's Report for August 2026.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the September 1, 2026 meeting minutes, by a vote of 3 ayes.
Approved the Director's Report for August 2026 by a vote of 3 ayes.
Approved a sewer credit of $175.96 to the property owner of 414 South Elm Street by a vote of 3 ayes.
